limitations.note: The rewrite retained the square wave’s 21-clock period instead of wrapping the counter and driving the output low at count 19, as the fix requires.

Although this reverses the triangle at 20 in steady state, it also changes reset and mode-entry behavior by replacing the registered direction logic; for example, the first triangle sample after reset becomes 1 instead of 31.
The square-wave rewrite forces the output low on entry at count 0, whereas the original and the correct fix hold the previous output until count 9.
The test encoded the rewrite’s 21-clock square period and upward triangle startup as expected behavior, so passing could not validate the required square timing or preserved triangle startup.
